attempts.text:
This plan rescues 12 of the 17 people and defers 5.

- **Myagang temple:** Kispang shelter is 16 minutes away. Both cars make one round trip, and each carries 4 people. That covers all 8 people there.
- **Galchhi temple:** The only usable route is via Gosaikunda temple, 41 minutes each way. Car1 does this after its Myagang trip. The round trip of 82 minutes is far cheaper than deferring four children, which would cost 240.
- **Dupcheshwar temple:** A round trip costs 52 minutes, but deferring the one elderly man costs 50, so deferring is slightly cheaper.
- **Tadi market and Naukunda farm:** Both are cut off, because the Tadi–Galchhi road is blocked and they connect only to each other. All five people there must be deferred.

<plan>
drive car1 kispang-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 injured 3
load car1 elderly 1
drive car1 myagang-temple kispang-shelter
unload car1 injured 3
unload car1 elderly 1
drive car2 kispang-shelter myagang-temple
load car2 adult 3
load car2 elderly 1
drive car2 myagang-temple kispang-shelter
unload car2 adult 3
unload car2 elderly 1
drive car1 kispang-shelter gosaikunda-temple
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple galchhi-temple
load car1 child 4
drive car1 galchhi-temple gosaikunda-temple
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple kispang-shelter
unload car1 child 4
defer dupcheshwar-temple elderly 1
defer naukunda-farm adult 2
defer tadi-market injured 3
</plan>

COST: 476

That is 146 minutes of driving plus 330 in deferral penalties (50 + 40 + 240).
